fields.title: Solomon Islands Business Registry entity profile / search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Detail-mode records (_source: S1-catalyst-entityview, the default) carry the full public profile, flattened generically from the registry's own Catalyst (Foster Moore) HTML widgets -- field names and grouping (e.g. director/shareholderInd/ownerind/filingsRepeater as lists) mirror upstream's own label text and CSS-class vocabulary verbatim, since the registry exposes no traditional JSON REST API and each register (Companies/Business Names/Foreign Investments) uses its own tab set and field labels. Summary-mode records (_source: S1-catalyst-searchresult, when 'Fetch full entity profile' is off) carry only the search-result row.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-catalyst-entityview (full profile), S1-catalyst-searchresult (summary row only), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing), click_failed / detail_fetch_failed / blocked_or_transient (network or session issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_tabs.title: Profile tabs fetched
_tabs.description: Detail mode only: the exact list of tab labels this entity's profile page had (varies by register -- e.g. Companies have Directors/Shares & Shareholders, Business Names have Owners).

entityViewUrl.title: Entity profile URL
entityViewUrl.description: The public registry permalink this detail record was extracted from.

label.title: Search result label
label.description: Summary-mode only: raw "<Name> (<RegistrationNumber>)" label as shown on the registry's search-results page.

name.title: Name
name.description: Summary-mode only: entity name parsed out of 'label'.

registrationNumber.title: Registration number
registrationNumber.description: Summary-mode only: registration number parsed out of 'label'.

entityTypeBadge.title: Entity type badge
entityTypeBadge.description: Summary-mode only: the register badge shown on the result row -- COM (Companies), BN (Business Names), or INV (Foreign Investments).

ItemAddress.title: Address (search result)
ItemAddress.description: Summary-mode only: the address line shown on the result row.

Company Name.title: Company name
Company Name.description: Detail mode (Companies), inside the currentEntityNames list.

Company Type.title: Company type
Company Type.description: Detail mode (Companies), e.g. Private Company / Public Company.

director.title: Directors
director.description: Detail mode (Companies): list of directors, each with Name/Nationality/Director Consent/Appointed Date, exactly as labeled by the registry.

shareholderInd.title: Shareholders
shareholderInd.description: Detail mode (Companies): list of individual shareholders, each with Name/Number of shares/Nationality/Appointed Date.

ownerind.title: Owners
ownerind.description: Detail mode (Business Names): list of individual owners, each with Name/Residential Address/Postal Address/Nationality/Appointed Date.

physicalAddress.title: Physical addresses
physicalAddress.description: Detail mode: registered office / principal place of business addresses on file.

postalAddress.title: Postal address
postalAddress.description: Detail mode: postal address on file.

filingsRepeater.title: Filing history
filingsRepeater.description: Detail mode: list of filings on record, each with Name (form/filing type)/Submitted/End (dates).

Total Shares.title: Total shares
Total Shares.description: Detail mode (Companies), from the Shares & Shareholders tab.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both full-profile and search-summary records. Additional register-specific columns (e.g. Company Status vs Business Name Status) are present in the raw record but not all shown here, since each register labels its own fields differently.
